# 58｜Lesson 58：A Spot of Bother

> 📌 **《新概念英语三 · 双语精讲》系列 · 第 58 篇 / 共 60 篇**
> 📖 Lesson 58 · 30 句 · 15 词 · 3 个语法点 · 6 道自测题

## 01 课文精读 · Text

**1. The old lady was glad to be back at the block of flats where she lived.**

老太太很高兴回到她住的公寓楼。

**2. Her shopping had tired her and her basket had grown heavier with every step of the way home.**

购物让她感到疲惫，回家的每一步都让她手里的篮子变得更沉。

**3. In the lift her thoughts were on lunch and a good rest;**

在电梯里，她想着午餐和好好休息；

**4. but when she got out at her own floor, both were forgotten in her sudden discovery that her front door was open.**

但当她走出电梯到达自己的楼层时，她突然发现前门开着，午餐和休息都被抛到了脑后。

**5. She was thinking that she must reprimand her home help the next morning for such a monstrous piece of negligence,**

她心想，明天早上一定要训斥她的家政人员，因为她如此严重的疏忽，

**6. when she remembered that she had gone shopping after the home help had left and she knew that she had turned both keys in their locks.**

但她随即想起，家政人员离开后她才去购物，而且她确定自己把两把钥匙都锁好了。

**7. She walked slowly into the hall and at once noticed that all the room doors were open,**

她慢慢地走进门厅，立刻注意到所有的房门都开着，

**8. yet following her regular practice she had shut them before going out.**

然而按照她的习惯，出门前她都会关好门。

**9. Looking into the drawing room, she saw a scene of confusion over by her writing desk.**

往客厅里一看，她看到写字台附近一片混乱。

**10. It was as clear as daylight then that burglars had forced an entry during her absence.**

这时，她才明白，在她外出期间，窃贼破门而入了，这简直是明摆着的事。

**11. Her first impulse was to go round all the rooms looking for the thieves,**

她最初的冲动是把所有房间都找一遍，看看有没有小偷，

**12. but then she decided that at her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her,**

但后来她觉得，以她的年纪，找个人陪着会更稳妥，

**13. so she went to fetch the porter from his basement.**

于是她下楼去地下室找看门人。

**14. By this time her legs were beginning to tremble, so she sat down and accepted a cup of very strong tea, while he telephoned the police.**

这时她的双腿开始颤抖，于是她坐下来，喝了一杯很浓的茶，看门人则打电话报了警。

**15. Then, her composure regained, she was ready to set off with the porter's assistance to search for any intruders who might still be lurking in her flat.**

恢复镇定后，她在看门人的协助下准备出发，搜寻可能仍藏在她公寓里的不速之客。

**16. They went through the rooms, being careful to touch nothing,**

他们检查了各个房间，小心翼翼地不碰任何东西，

**17. as they did not want to hinder the police in their search for fingerprints.**

因为他们不想妨碍警方寻找指纹。

**18. The chaos was inconceivable.**

现场一片狼藉，简直难以置信。

**19. She had lived in the flat for thirty years and was a veritable magpie at hoarding:**

她在这间公寓住了三十年，是个名副其实的“喜鹊”，喜欢囤积物品：

**20. and it seemed as though everything she possessed had been tossed out and turned over and over.**

似乎她所有的东西都被翻了出来，翻了个底朝天。

**21. At least sorting out the things she should have discarded years ago was now being made easier for her.**

至少，现在整理那些她几年前就该扔掉的东西变得容易多了。

**22. Then a police inspector arrived with a constable and she told them of her discovery of the ransacked flat.**

随后，一名警督带着一名警员赶到，她向他们讲述了她发现公寓被洗劫一空的情况。

**23. The inspector began to look for fingerprints, while the constable checked that the front door locks had not been forced,**

警督开始寻找指纹，而警员则检查前门锁是否没有被撬，

**24. thereby proving that the burglars had either used skeleton keys or entered over the balcony.**

这证明窃贼要么使用了万能钥匙，要么是从阳台进入的。

**25. There was no trace of fingerprints, but the inspector found a dirty red bundle that contained jewellery which the old lady said was not hers.**

没有指纹痕迹，但警督发现了一个脏兮兮的红色包裹，里面装着珠宝，老太太说那不是她的。

**26. So their entry into this flat was apparently not the burglars' first job that day and they must have been disturbed.**

所以他们闯入这间公寓显然不是窃贼当天做的第一起案子，而且他们一定是在作案时受到了惊扰。

**27. The inspector then asked the old lady to try to check what was missing by the next day,**

警督随后要求老太太在第二天之前尽量清点一下丢失的物品，

**28. and advised her not to stay alone in the flat for a few nights.**

并建议她几晚不要独自待在公寓里。

**29. The old lady thought he was a fussy creature,**

老太太觉得他是个爱挑剔的人，

**30. but since the porter agreed with him, she rang up her daughter and asked for her help in what she described as a little spot of bother.**

但看门人也同意他的看法，于是她打电话给女儿，请她帮忙解决她所说的“一点小麻烦”。

## 03 语法精讲 · Grammar

**1. 过去完成时 (Past Perfect Tense)**

`had + 过去分词`

表示在过去某一时刻之前已经完成的动作，常用于描述过去的背景或先发生的事件

当需要表达'过去的过去'这一概念时使用，常与when, after, before等连用，或用于宾语从句中

**例句：She had gone shopping after the home help had left.**

她在管家离开后才去购物。

**2. 过去进行时 (Past Continuous Tense)**

`was/were + 动词-ing`

表示在过去某一时刻正在进行的动作，或用来描述过去的背景

常用于描述故事发生的背景，或与when/while等连用表示两个同时进行的动作

**例句：Her thoughts were on lunch and a good rest.**

她满脑子想的都是午餐和好好休息。

**3. must have + 过去分词**

`must have + 过去分词`

表示对过去发生的事情的推测，意为'一定/肯定做过某事'

用于根据现有证据或情况对过去事件进行肯定性的推测

**例句：They must have been disturbed.**

他们一定是被打扰了。

## 04 句型模仿 · Patterns

- **主语 + be glad to + 动词原形**
  - 课文原句：The old lady was glad to be back at the block of flats.（老太太很高兴回到她住的公寓。）
  - 仿写：I was glad to see my old friends again.（我很高兴再次见到我的老朋友们。）
- **主语 + be/feel + 形容词 + to + 动词原形**
  - 课文原句：At her age it might be more prudent to have someone with her.（在她这个年纪，有人陪着可能更明智。）
  - 仿写：It might be better to wait for the police.（等待警察可能更好。）
- **It is + 形容词 + that...**
  - 课文原句：It was as clear as daylight that burglars had forced an entry.（显而易见，窃贼强行闯入了。）
  - 仿写：It is obvious that she has been robbed.（很明显她被抢劫了。）
- **主语 + had + 过去分词 + before + doing something**
  - 课文原句：She had shut them before going out.（她在出门前把门都关上了。）
  - 仿写：He had finished his homework before watching TV.（他在看电视前已经完成了作业。）
